title: 한국 음식 처음 먹어 본 이야기: 결국 눈물이 나고 말았어요
objective: Tell a short story about your first Korean dish, using -고 말다 for things that happened against your plan.
summary: Two friends talk about the first time one of them ate Korean food.
setting: Two friends, Jisu (Korean) and Mark (from abroad), are chatting at a café about the first Korean food Mark ever ate.

task.title: Tell your food story
task.line: Read each instruction, then choose, fill in, or rewrite the Korean using the words and the -고 말다 pattern from the dialogue.

words.meaning: to try (a food) for the first time
words.exampleMeaning: Today is my first time trying kimchi stew.
Can I try just one bite?
I put in too much wasabi, and my eyes watered.
I was full, but in the end I ordered dessert too.

words.meaning: to be scared of; to find something scary
words.exampleMeaning: At first, the look of silkworm pupae scared me a little.

dialogue.korean: 마크 씨, 한국 음식 중에서 처음 먹어 본 게 뭐였어요?
dialogue.meaning: Mark, what was the first Korean food you ever tried?

dialogue.korean: 떡볶이요. 한국에 온 첫날 친구가 사 줬어요.
dialogue.meaning: Tteokbokki. A friend bought it for me on my first day in Korea.

dialogue.korean: 한 입은 괜찮았는데, 조금 지나니까 입에 불이 나는 것 같았어요. 결국 눈물이 나고 말았어요.
dialogue.meaning: The first bite was okay, but after a bit my mouth felt like it was on fire. In the end, I couldn't stop the tears.
So can you eat tteokbokki easily now?

dialogue.korean: 지금은 일주일에 한 번은 꼭 먹어요. 그런데 산낙지는 아직 무서워요. 지난번에 식당에서 보고 그냥 젓가락을 내려놓고 말았어요.
dialogue.meaning: Now I eat it at least once a week. But live octopus still scares me. Last time I saw it at a restaurant, I just put my chopsticks down.

dialogue.korean: 저도 처음에는 못 먹었어요. 움직이니까 좀 이상하잖아요.
dialogue.meaning: I couldn't eat it at first either. It's a bit strange because it moves, right?

exercises: Fill in the blank with -고 말다 in the past tense (울다): 마라탕이 너무 매워서 친구 앞에서 ____.
Fill in each blank with a word from the box (한 입, 1인분, 결국): ① 떡국 ____만 먹어 봐도 돼요? ② 혼자 와서 불고기 ____만 시켰어요. ③ 안 사려고 했는데 ____ 샀어요.
Based on the dialogue, write O (true) or X (false): ① 마크 씨가 처음 먹은 한국 음식은 떡볶이예요. ② 마크 씨는 혼자 떡볶이를 사 먹었어요. ③ 마크 씨는 지금 산낙지를 잘 먹어요. ④ 지수 씨도 처음에는 산낙지를 못 먹었어요.
Rewrite the sentence using -고 말다 to show you didn't plan it: 김치가 너무 매워서 물을 세 잔이나 마셨어요.
answers: ① 한 입 ② 1인분 ③ 결국
① O ② X ③ X ④ O
김치가 너무 매워서 물을 세 잔이나 마시고 말았어요.
